scope: Offline long-only research only. Extends the frozen primary router and routed 50/50 E/T upstream to a target-free August panel, then permits the frozen U contract to train strictly before its reserve from immutable historical E/T panels. It does not change live inference, MC1 thresholds, admission, portfolio state, exchange state, or execution.

contracts.router: The primary router selects the exact timestamp-local top 50 percent. Its numeric score has no base, U, MC1, or portfolio feature authority.
contracts.upstream: enhanced_base_bps = 0.50 * efficiency_bps + 0.50 * timing_bps, with no direct R3 ranking authority.
contracts.target_free: Forward candidate identities and causal features are materialised before scoring; held policy/path labels are not opened by the E/T scorer.
contracts.multi_source: Historical and forward immutable source roots may be joined only by a single exact monthly owner and stable candidate identity. A full-universe causal feature panel may cover, but never replace, a router-selected source population.
contracts.causality: E/T and U training rows must be routed and label-resolved before each 28-day reserve. U held scores persist before outcome diagnostics.

validation_plan: python3 -m py_compile of all changed Python files
target-free identity/coverage audit for the August router and E/T base panels
one strict July full-causal superset-to-routed-subset U fold preparation check
strict August U scoring, dual-MC1, admission, and constrained-portfolio audit after materialisation completes
